summary: Conquest Hold is the Muramite Dominion’s primary staging ground for planar invasions. Armies gather in the mustering fields, warlords command from fortified ramparts, and the Invasion Gateworks channel Discord energy into stable assault portals.
history: Conquest Hold was established after the Muramite unification under the first Imperator.
Mustering Fields became the assembly grounds for massive legion deployments.
Command Ramparts were built to oversee troop movement and enforce discipline.
Warpath Barricades formed as defensive choke points against Riftlands incursions.
Invasion Gateworks enabled the full-scale assault on Kuua and other planar targets.
